title: Mexican Chopped Salad
description: A fresh and colorful Mexican chopped salad packed with crisp vegetables, roasted corn, black beans, Cotija cheese, and crunchy tortilla strips, all tossed in a zesty lime vinaigrette. Perfect as a refreshing side dish or a satisfying main with your favorite protein.

ingredients.title: Salad Base
items: Romaine lettuce, finely chopped – 4 cups
Red cabbage, finely shredded – 1 cup
Radicchio or iceberg, finely chopped – 1 cup
Corn kernels, roasted or grilled – 1 cup
Black beans, rinsed and drained – 1 cup
Large red bell pepper, finely diced – 1
Large yellow bell pepper, finely diced – 1
Medium cucumber, seeded and diced – 1
Medium red onion, finely diced – 1
Cherry tomatoes, quartered – 1 cup
Jicama, finely diced – ½ cup (optional, for crunch)
Fresh cilantro, chopped – ½ cup
Radishes, thinly sliced – ¼ cup (optional garnish)

ingredients.title: Cheese & Crunch
items: Cotija cheese, crumbled – ½ cup
Tortilla strips or crispy baked tortilla chips, lightly salted – ½ cup

ingredients.title: Dressing (Zesty Lime Vinaigrette)
items: Extra virgin olive oil – ¼ cup
Freshly squeezed lime juice – 2 tbsp
Apple cider vinegar – 1 tbsp
Honey or agave syrup – 1 tsp
Dijon mustard – 1 tsp
Garlic clove, minced – 1
Smoked paprika – ½ tsp
Salt & freshly ground black pepper – to taste
Chipotle chili powder – ½ tsp (optional, for a smoky kick)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prep the Vegetables
steps: Finely chop all lettuce, cabbage, and radicchio. Dice cucumbers, bell peppers, and jicama. Quarter cherry tomatoes. Keep ingredients separate if making ahead to maintain crispness.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Roast the Corn (Optional but Recommended)
steps: Toss corn kernels with a touch of olive oil, salt, and smoked paprika. Roast at 400°F (200°C) for 10–12 minutes until slightly charred. This adds depth and sweetness.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Dressing
steps: Whisk together lime juice, apple cider vinegar, honey, Dijon mustard, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking to emulsify. Adjust seasoning to taste.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assemble the Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine all chopped vegetables, beans, roasted corn, and cilantro. Toss lightly with 2–3 tbsp of the dressing, keeping some dressing aside for serving. The salad should be lightly coated, not drenched.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plate Like a Top Restaurant
steps: Serve on chilled plates for a fresh presentation.
Sprinkle crumbled Cotija cheese evenly over the top.
Add crunchy tortilla strips or chips just before serving to retain texture.
Garnish with thinly sliced radishes and extra cilantro for color.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Optional Protein Upgrade
steps: Top with grilled shrimp, chicken, or skirt steak for a main-course version.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a refreshing side dish.
Pair with tacos, grilled meats, enchiladas, or fajitas.
Top with grilled shrimp, chicken, or skirt steak for a complete meal.

chefTips: Knife Skills: Uniform, fine chopping ensures each bite has every flavor.
Layer Textures: Combine crisp, soft, creamy, and crunchy elements.
Balance Flavors: Sweet (corn), tangy (lime), smoky (paprika), salty (Cotija) – all should be present.
Freshness: Assemble just before serving; dressing too early wilts the greens.
